evidence_labels.RECORDED: Written in a federal record (FEMA NSS, Census ACS, CDC SVI, CMS, FEMA NRI). Historical: describes what was filed, not necessarily what is true today.
evidence_labels.UNRECORDED: The field is blank. Nobody wrote it down. This is never the same as 'no'.
evidence_labels.VERIFIED LIVE: Checked against Google Maps during this session, with a timestamp.
evidence_labels.MODELED: A statistical estimate (CDC PLACES), not a count.
evidence_labels.COUNTY-LEVEL: Published per county only (HHS emPOWER). Says how many, never which tract.
evidence_labels.APPROXIMATE: Derived from a federal record by our own approximation, such as a shelter matched to its nearest census tract centroid. Describes the neighbourhood, not the building.
